title.zh: 一个反应往哪边走，能走多远
title.en: Which Way a Reaction Goes, and How Far

desc.zh: 冰会自己化，铁会自己锈，氮气和氢气却要高温高压才肯变成氨。一个反应会不会发生、能走多远，由谁决定？这篇从数排法讲起：熵，玻尔兹曼因子，吉布斯自由能，化学势，平衡常数，催化剂为什么不改变终点，碳为什么炼得出铁却炼不出铝，合成氨的塔为什么又热又压，再到绿氨、电解水和从空气里捕集二氧化碳离热力学下限还有多远。十二个可以动手的模型，数据来自 NIST 的热化学表。
desc.en: Ice melts by itself and iron rusts by itself, yet nitrogen and hydrogen need heat and pressure to become ammonia. What decides whether a reaction goes, and how far? This essay starts from counting arrangements: entropy, the Boltzmann factor, Gibbs free energy, chemical potential, the equilibrium constant, why a catalyst does not move the end point, why carbon smelts iron but not aluminium, why an ammonia converter is hot and pressurised, and how far green ammonia, water electrolysis and direct air capture are from their thermodynamic minimum. Twelve hands-on models, with data from the NIST thermochemical tables.

title.zh: 自发性：看总熵，不看放热吸热
title.en: Spontaneity: total entropy, not heat released

desc.zh: 一个过程会不会自己发生，取决于系统和周围的熵之和是否增加；吸热过程也可以自发。
desc.en: A process goes by itself when the entropy of system plus surroundings rises; endothermic processes can be spontaneous.

zh: 吸热反应为什么能自发
反应为什么会自己发生
热力学第二定律 化学
en: why does ice melt by itself

title.zh: 熵是排法数的对数：S = k ln W
title.en: Entropy counts arrangements: S = k ln W

desc.zh: 熵是微观排法数的对数；系统走向排法最多的宏观状态。用爱因斯坦固体数出来。
desc.en: Entropy is the log of the number of microstates; systems move to the macrostate with the most. Counted on Einstein solids.

zh: 热为什么从热的流向冷的
en: why heat flows hot to cold

desc.zh: 小系统从热库借能量 ε，热库的排法数乘以 e^(−ε/kT)，这就是高能态的相对概率。
desc.en: A small system taking energy ε from a bath multiplies the bath’s microstates by e^(−ε/kT): the relative probability of the higher state.

zh: 玻尔兹曼因子怎么来的
en: where does the Boltzmann factor come from

title.zh: 吉布斯自由能 ΔG = ΔH − TΔS
title.en: Gibbs free energy ΔG = ΔH − TΔS

desc.zh: 恒温恒压下 ΔG < 0 等价于总熵增加；ΔH 和 ΔS 的四种符号组合决定反应在什么温度下自发。
desc.en: At constant T and p, ΔG < 0 is the same as total entropy rising; the four sign combinations of ΔH and ΔS decide at which temperatures a reaction goes.

zh: 吉布斯自由能是什么意思
焓变 熵变 判断自发

title.en: Chemical potential and extent of reaction

desc.zh: 化学势是每多一摩尔物质自由能增加多少；G 随反应进度有一个由混合熵造成的最低点，那就是平衡。
desc.en: Chemical potential is the free energy added per mole of a substance; G against extent of reaction has a minimum made by mixing entropy, and that is equilibrium.

en: why reactions do not go to completion

title.zh: 反应商 Q、平衡常数 K 与范特霍夫方程
title.en: Reaction quotient Q, equilibrium constant K and the van ’t Hoff equation

desc.zh: ΔrG = ΔG° + RT ln Q；K = e^(−ΔG°/RT)；勒夏特列原理是 Q 与 K 比较的推论；ln K 对 1/T 是直线。
desc.en: ΔrG = ΔG° + RT ln Q; K = e^(−ΔG°/RT); Le Chatelier follows from comparing Q with K; ln K against 1/T is a line.

zh: 勒夏特列原理为什么成立
温度怎么影响平衡常数

title.zh: 热力学与动力学：催化剂不改变平衡
title.en: Thermodynamics versus kinetics: a catalyst does not move equilibrium

desc.zh: ΔG 决定终点，能垒决定速率（艾林方程）；催化剂同时加快正逆反应，K 不变。
desc.en: ΔG sets the end point, the barrier sets the rate (Eyring); a catalyst speeds both directions and leaves K unchanged.

zh: 催化剂为什么不改变平衡
钻石为什么不变成石墨
热力学可行 动力学不可行
en: why a catalyst does not change equilibrium
why diamond does not turn into graphite

title.zh: 反应耦合：ATP、ΔG = −nFE 与埃林厄姆图
title.en: Coupled reactions: ATP, ΔG = −nFE and the Ellingham diagram

desc.zh: 上坡的反应绑上更陡的下坡反应就能发生：细胞用 ATP，电池用电子，高炉用碳；铝要电解。
desc.en: An uphill reaction goes when tied to a steeper downhill one: cells use ATP, cells of a battery use electrons, a furnace uses carbon; aluminium needs electrolysis.

zh: 为什么碳能炼铁不能炼铝
en: why carbon reduces iron but not aluminium

title.zh: 合成氨：平衡与速率的折中
title.en: Ammonia synthesis: the compromise between equilibrium and rate

desc.zh: 合成氨放热且减少气体分子：低温高压利于平衡，但低温太慢；模型用 NIST 数据和焦姆金–佩热夫速率方程。
desc.en: Ammonia synthesis is exothermic and makes fewer gas molecules: cold and pressure favour equilibrium, but cold is too slow. Modelled with NIST data and the Temkin–Pyzhev rate law.

zh: 合成氨为什么要高温高压
en: why Haber process uses high temperature and pressure

title.zh: 相分离：正规溶液与公切线
title.en: Phase separation: regular solution and the common tangent

desc.zh: 混合熵与相互作用能竞争；χ > 2 时自由能曲线出现双谷，混合物沿公切线分成两相。
desc.en: Mixing entropy competes with interaction energy; above χ = 2 the free-energy curve has two wells and the mixture splits along the common tangent.

zh: 电池电压平台为什么是平的
en: why oil and water do not mix

title.zh: 离热力学下限多远：绿氨、电解水、空气捕碳
title.en: Distance from the thermodynamic minimum: green ammonia, electrolysis, direct air capture

desc.zh: 电解水最低 1.23 V，空气捕碳最小功约 19 kJ/mol；2026 年 11 月的现状按已确立、已做出、说法三类列出。
desc.en: Water electrolysis needs at least 1.23 V and direct air capture about 19 kJ/mol; the state as of November 2026, split into established, demonstrated and claimed.

zh: 直接空气捕集要多少能量
en: how much electricity to make hydrogen

title.zh: 看一个反应先问四件事
title.en: Four questions to ask of any reaction

desc.zh: 方向看 ΔG，限度看 Q 与 K，速度看能垒，代价看离 ΔG 多远。
desc.en: Direction from ΔG, extent from Q against K, speed from the barrier, cost from the distance to ΔG.

zh: 怎么判断一个反应能不能发生
反应方向 限度 速率
en: how to tell if a reaction will happen
direction extent rate of a reaction
